text: Ask one question you were going to keep to yourself.
Say "I'm not sure" out loud instead of pretending you know.
Disagree politely with something instead of nodding along.
Ask one question even if your voice does the tiny wobble thing.
Say what you need clearly, without apologizing for needing it.
Start the assignment for five minutes. You may complain during all five.
Open the thing you've been avoiding. Just open it.
Try something you're bad at, on purpose, for ten minutes.
Sign up for something before you feel ready.
Start the big project today with one ugly first draft.
Say hi to someone you usually walk past.
Give someone a specific compliment. Not "nice shirt." Tell them exactly what you noticed.
Invite someone into a conversation instead of waiting.
Ask someone how they're actually doing, then listen to the whole answer.
Sit with someone you don't know well and stay the whole time.
Say "sorry about that" the moment you know it's true.
Retry something that went badly yesterday.
Correct a misunderstanding instead of quietly letting it become your new personality.
Apologize for something small, without adding "but."
Reach out to someone after an awkward moment and clear the air.
Tell someone your honest opinion about a movie, song, or snack.
Wear or bring something you like that's a little bit "you."
Show someone something you made before you decide whether it is good.
Share an idea in class or a group, even half-formed.
Share something you made or wrote with a small group.
Say "no thanks" to something you don't want, with no long explanation.
Say "I need a minute" when you need one.
Ask for help before you're completely stuck.
Check in with someone who seems left out.
Tell a trusted person when you need backup.
